description.en: Language-side LoRA with frozen visual components and the original LM head; checkpoint save/reload smoke is verified in Lab.
description.zh: 冻结视觉与原 LM head 的语言侧 LoRA；Lab 已验证保存、恢复与重载 smoke。

limitations.en: Formal gains are unmeasured; cross-source near-duplicate audit and four-role split review remain prerequisites.
limitations.zh: 正式训练收益未测；仍需跨源近重复审核与四类划分审查。

description.en: An independent candidate head loaded from an explicit R1 checkpoint; real-gradient and reload smoke exists in Lab.
description.zh: 从显式 R1 checkpoint 加入独立 candidate head；Lab 已有真实梯度与重载 smoke。

limitations.en: Requires R1 provenance and an equal-step continuation control; this is not a validated full training recipe.
limitations.zh: 需要 R1 来源与等步继续训练对照；不是已验证的正式训练配方。
